subject: pathology
title: Environmental and nutritional pathology

steps.tx: Environmental pathology links exposures at work and home to later disease. **Environmental exposures** injure by dose and duration, and **tobacco** remains the largest preventable cause of disease overall. Host susceptibility modifies harm considerably, and long latency hides the cause until exposure patterns are recognised by careful history taking.
steps.say: Exposures injure tissues by dose, duration and host susceptibility acting together over time. Latency is long because disease appears years after exposure has ended often. Tobacco is the largest preventable cause across cancer and vascular disease combined. Pattern recognition is essential because history links exposure to disease.

steps.tx: Heavy metals produce distinctive syndromes that examiners test as spot diagnoses. **Lead poisoning** impairs haem synthesis and causes stippling, and **mercury poisoning** causes tremor with personality change called erethism. Arsenic causes raindrop pigmentation and nail lines, whereas cadmium injures kidney and bone and produces severe bone pain.
steps.say: Lead impairs haem synthesis and basophilic stippling appears in red cells characteristically. Abdominal colic occurs and wrist drop develops from peripheral nerve injury progressively. Mercury causes tremor whereas arsenic pigments skin and produces nail lines distinctively. Cadmium damages kidney because proximal tubular injury accumulates over years.

vis.alt: Composite image showing Burton lines, wrist drop (lead), Mees lines, raindrop pigmentation (arsenic), and tremors (mercury), illustrating key clinical signs of heavy metal poisoning.
vis.caption: Clinical signs of heavy metal poisoning

steps.tx: Inhaled mineral dusts cause fibrosis with patterns that separate them clearly. **Asbestos** causes lower lobe fibrosis and pleural plaques, and **silica** causes upper lobe fibrosis with eggshell nodal calcification. Asbestos also causes mesothelioma after decades, whereas silica increases tuberculosis risk, and coal dust usually causes mild fibrosis unless massive fibrosis develops.
steps.say: Asbestos scars lower lobes and pleura after latency of several decades typically. Mesothelioma develops in pleura and lung cancer risk multiplies with smoking exposure. Silica scars upper lobes because inhaled particles concentrate in those regions preferentially. Tuberculosis risk rises because silica impairs macrophage function in lungs.

steps.tx: This chest CT shows calcified pleural plaques with lower lobe subpleural fibrosis. **Calcified pleural plaques** mark asbestos exposure, and **asbestosis fibrosis** is shown in the lower lobes bilaterally. This combination matters because it separates asbestos disease from upper lobe silica fibrosis and supports the exposure history in examination stems.
steps.say: This axial scan shows bright calcified plaques along the parietal pleura bilaterally. Fibrosis is present in lower lobes with a subpleural distribution pattern clearly. Plaques indicate exposure whereas fibrosis indicates parenchymal asbestosis in this patient. Latency is long because disease appears decades after inhalation.

vis.alt: Axial chest CT with arrows indicating calcified parietal pleural plaques bilaterally and lower lobe subpleural fibrosis from asbestosis.
vis.caption: Axial chest CT showing pleural plaques and lower lobe fibrosis. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Vitamin deficiencies produce classic syndromes that reverse when treated early. **Scurvy** from vitamin C deficiency impairs collagen formation, and **vitamin D deficiency** softens bone as rickets or osteomalacia. Vitamin A deficiency causes night blindness and xerophthalmia, whereas thiamine deficiency causes beriberi heart failure or Wernicke encephalopathy in alcohol misuse.
steps.say: Scurvy bleeds gums because collagen hydroxylation fails without vitamin C availability normally. Wounds reopen and perifollicular haemorrhages appear in untreated deficiency over weeks. Rickets softens growing bone whereas osteomalacia softens mature bone in adults predominantly. Thiamine deficiency damages heart and brain because energy metabolism fails.

steps.tx: Malnutrition harms at both deficiency and excess ends of nutrition. **Marasmus** wastes the body without oedema, and **kwashiorkor** causes oedema with fatty liver despite some calorie intake. Protein lack drives the kwashiorkor picture with flaky paint skin, whereas obesity drives metabolic syndrome, steatohepatitis, sleep apnoea and joint failure.
steps.say: Marasmus wastes muscles and fat because total calorie intake is severely deficient chronically. Kwashiorkor causes oedema because protein intake is lacking despite calories being present. Fatty liver develops and flaky paint skin changes appear in kwashiorkor classically. Obesity is harmful because metabolic and mechanical complications accumulate over years.
